evidence.note: This paper measures how much of the value of test-time repair episodes in text-to-SQL survives when they are stored as a per-database memory bank and reused on new questions, isolating replay, cross-question retention, and held-out transfer, and finding that verified, database-specific memory captures 44.4% of the on-demand repair headroom on BIRD.
evidence.title: From Test-Time Scaling to Reusable Memory: Measuring Crystallization in Text-to-SQL
